evidence.reason: The test creates only runs/r1 and asserts a bare ValueError for every bad ID. If the unsafe-ID guard were removed, these IDs would still resolve to absent run paths (or the parent for "..") and load_run would raise ValueError for missing/unusable run data, so the test would still pass. It therefore does not distinguish invalid-ID rejection from missing-run failure, as the finding alleges. This is a routine test correctness repair, not a new requirement.
